stats.done_summary: Successfully completed retail analytics research task. Analyzed 200 stores over 3 years (7,200 observations) to evaluate RET-ADV-ROLL policy and optimize ad spend allocation. All deliverables created: analysis code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and publication-quality report in report/report.md with embedded visualizations.
